instructions: Compare the changed clause with the linked clause; they neither contradict nor overstep each other. Do they say the same thing? Answer yes when both clauses describe the same behavior, surface, or responsibility. Answer no when they describe different things, even if related. A criterion or test that checks the behavior the other clause states says the same thing: yes.

labels.name: yes
labels.description: Both clauses describe the same behavior, surface, or responsibility. A criterion or test that checks the behavior the other clause states says the same thing.

input.before: The server stores one judgment record for each question.
input.target: The records are the cache: each is keyed by a hash of its question inputs and set version.

input.after: Given a saved filter, choosing it from the toolbar applies it.
input.target: Saved filters appear in the toolbar list and apply when chosen.

input.after: Decided by the human, 2026-09-24: the page uses BB's Terminal icon. The plugin's sidebar rows are exactly Spec, Proof, Terminal, Human inbox, in that order.
input.target: The Human inbox row, titled Human inbox since ANN-236 and formerly Kanban, is a normal plugin page, not an embedded service page.

labels.name: no
labels.description: The clauses describe different behavior, even if related. Pairs that restate, extend, belong to another layer, are sibling rows of one table, or name a Jev label word such as overlaps are no when they describe different things.

input.before: The cache key includes the source revision.
input.after: The cache key includes the source revision and set version.
input.target: Mobile markers stay visible at narrow widths.

input.after: The export route returns CSV and names the file after the report.
input.target: The report header shows the report's owner and its creation date.

input.after: The invoice exporter reads saved reports only through the report store's read interface and writes no record of its own.
input.target: The report store keys each saved report by its owner and creation date and returns it unchanged on read.

input.after: The export settings file owns the CSV column order. Caller-facing seam: a settings id and version, loaded by the existing settings loader.
input.target: Settings files own formats, defaults, and limits. Caller-facing seam: a settings id and version.

verify.rule: Read both clauses as wholes and choose one level. For same or partial, quote the exact span from the clause and the target that carry the shared content. For different, leave spans empty.

same.description: The two clauses state the same thing as a whole: each quoted span carries its clause's main point. A criterion or test that checks the whole behavior the other clause states is same.

partial.description: One clause repeats one part of the other on the same surface and actor: a criterion or test that checks one sub-claim of a broader clause, or a clause that restates one point of a longer one.

different.description: Anything else: the same rule held for a different surface or actor, a module boundary against one feature's behavior (another layer), or only a shared phrase or topic.
